assumes.ja: 確率で付く持続ダメージを期待値で持つ（1 発ごとに値 7 の % で付く。plan/design-chance-dot-damage.md 3.1 節）。付き直しは刻みを変えずに維持を延ばし（C-0129 の形）、tick は付いた瞬間と 1.5 秒後から 1 秒ごと（C-0101 の形）。起点ごとの tick に、その tick が出る確率を掛ける。付き直しの形・tick の時刻・付くフレーム（発と同じ）・tick がゲージを溜めないことは確かめていない
assumes.en: The chance-based sustained damage is modelled as an expectation (each shot applies it with value 7 %; plan/design-chance-dot-damage.md 3.1). Reapplying extends the duration without changing the tick grid (as in C-0129), and ticks come at application and from 1.5 s on every second (as in C-0101). Each tick of each possible first application is weighted by the probability that it occurs. The reapply shape, tick timing, application frame (the shot frame) and that ticks charge no Burst gauge are unverified

notes.ja: 敵が撃破された時の、最も近い敵へのウイルス転移の広がりは、射撃場の敵が倒れないので起きない（敵 1 体の前提。要件 4.2 節）
notes.en: Spreading Virus Transfer to the nearest enemies when an enemy is brought down does not occur, since the range enemy is never defeated (a single enemy; requirements 4.2)

assumes.ja: 貫通特化（1 発間維持）。フルチャージの発の後に付いて次の 1 発に乗る（C-0868 の形）。それ自体は与ダメージを変えず、味方の貫通ダメージ▲の乗る発にする
assumes.en: Pierce (lasts 1 round). Applied after a Full Charge shot and rides on the next shot (as in C-0868). It does not change damage by itself; it makes the shot one that allies' Pierce Damage ups apply to

assumes.ja: クリティカル確率▲（1 発間維持）。フルチャージの発の後に付いて次の 1 発の会心率に足す（C-0868 の形）。オート射撃ではどの発もフルチャージなので、戦闘の最初の発の後のどの発にも乗る
assumes.en: Crit Rate up (lasts 1 round). Applied after a Full Charge shot and added to the next shot's crit rate (as in C-0868). With auto fire every shot is a Full Charge shot, so it applies to every shot after the first

notes.ja: 敵を倒した時の自分の攻撃力▲（スタック）は、射撃場の敵が倒れないので起きない（敵 1 体の前提。要件 4.2 節）
notes.en: ATK up on self when defeating an enemy (stacking) does not occur, since the range enemy is never defeated (a single enemy; requirements 4.2)

assumes.ja: 敵全体は単体ボスで 1 ヒット。ヒットの遅れは撮っていない（遅れの表に無く、発動と同じフレーム）
assumes.en: All enemies are a lone boss, so it lands once. The hit delay is not measured (not in the delay table; the activation frame)
